fields.summary_ko.0: Lucid Group (LCID) secured additional $1.75B credit facility from Saudi PIF, reaching total liquidity of $3.75B with operating funds secured through Q4 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 revenue $350.3M versus net loss $830.9M recorded, with cash burn down 30% to $1.04B, though quarterly burn exceeding $1B continues; midsize SUV delay may require additional funding.
